scientific_integrity: Claims are self-reviewed; the proof is analytic, with finite independent-code cross-checks only. General graph universality follows from integer feasible circulation, not brute force. The published complete-bipartite special case and standard balancing/matching methods are credited.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple biregular bipartite base graphs; classical edge spins; two strictly positive endpoint-class couplings; uniform field; zero temperature. Does not determine a general critical degeneracy outside saturation or finite-temperature statistics. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Topology-independent Ising field staircases and topology-dependent matching entropy on biregular line graphs
